codes.title: Client codes
codes.changeDescription: Current primary code: {{code}}. The previous primary code will automatically be saved as an alternative. Temporary codes are not saved.
codes.addDescription: Enter an additional code that can be used to find this client.
codes.removeDescription: Remove alternative code {{code}}? Existing parcels will remain with this client.
codes.conflict: This code is already assigned to another client
codes.invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 2147483647
codes.failed: Could not save changes. Please try again.
codes.manageDescription: Add or remove alternative codes, or make one the primary client code.

resolution.title: Your client code needs to be confirmed
resolution.description: Contact a manager to restore your code and access the app. Your parcels are saved. Reload this page after your code has been restored.
resolution.signOutFailed: Could not sign out. Please try again.

merge.title: Merge clients
merge.changed: Client data has changed. Review the updated result and confirm again.
merge.notFound: One of the clients is no longer available. Select a client again.
merge.failed: Could not merge clients. Please try again.
merge.searchFailed: Could not find the client. Please try again.
merge.invalidCode: Enter a nonzero integer code from -2147483648 to 2147483647.
merge.accountDescription: The selected account will have access to all parcels. The primary client code will stay the same.
merge.accountClosed: Account {{phone}} will be deleted. Its active sessions will end and it will no longer be possible to sign in to this account.
merge.samePerson: I have verified that both clients belong to the same person
merge.adminAccount: An administrator account cannot be deleted during a merge. Select it as the account to keep.
merge.confirmationRequired: Select an account to keep and confirm that both clients belong to the same person.
